Problem: An arithmetic sequence \(\{a_n\}\) has \(2n+1\) terms, the sum of all odd terms is \(132\), and the sum of all even terms is \(120\). Find the value of \(n\). Express your answer as a whole number.

<reflection>

In a sequence with $2n+1$ terms, the odd-indexed terms are $a_1,a_3,\dots,a_{2n+1}$, which number $n+1$, not $n$. The even-indexed terms number $n$.
